text:
Kai: quick heads-up — p99 on /v1/chat-us jumped ~140ms after we changed quota routing at ~01:10 UTC. p50/p95 steady. https://console.redwood.ai/d/latency-chat-us :eyes:
Anya: saw it in the alert. any recent route/quota changes?
Kai: quota config bumped fallback->cheap-quant from 0.08 to 0.38 at 01:09 by autoscaler.
Rafael: that would increase cheap-quant hits. median for cheap-quant matches, but its tail is worse on cache cold starts
Kai: router log snippet around change:
```
[01:09:57] quota_backoff start route=chat-us fallback=cheap-quant rate=0.38
[01:09:58] model_select req=aa7 model=cheap-quant seq=712
[01:09:59] kvcache_miss req=aa7 prefix=session_
```
Anya: looked at rollup: p99 computed from ~230 samples last hour vs p95 ~10k. p99 is low-sample noisy and also has more cheap-quant influence — two causes
Rafael: ops plan: (1) revert fallback to 0.08 now (Kai), (2) add sample-count next to each percentile and show a small confidence band on p99 (Anya), (3) UI: small chevron next to p99 that expands to per-variant percentiles and sample counts (Rafael)
Kai: +1. Also annotate chart with the quota event for provenance.
metrics-bot: deploy-bot: rollback requested by Kai. Reverting route chat-us fallback -> 0.08
Anya: UX idea for chevron expand: show per-variant sparkline + p50/p95/p99 + sample_count and a tiny "CI" glyph that when hovered shows estimated percentile variance (based on sample count)
Rafael: backend note: when merging tdigest shards include per-shard counts and origin tags (route, fallback-rate) so frontend can compute confidence and flag low-sample percentiles
Kai: short-term watch window 12m. if p99 doesn't normalize we'll run a controlled traffic test with KV priming to isolate cold-cache vs model tail
Anya: I'll mock the chevron expand and confidence band. can we also add a route-table column "fallback-ratio" so owners can see correlation quickly?
Rafael: yes — route metadata store can export fallback_ratio per-minute. long-term: expose per-model percentiles in endpoint pane and a provenance timeline strip (route/quota/model-variant changes)
Kai: thanks all. i'll post a tiny incident note into #incidents with timeline and link to this thread.
Anya: ACK
Rafael: ACK :thumbsup:
